title: AkshitaSood Video
transcript: Hi, I am Akshita Sood, currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at VIT Bhopal University. I really enjoy solving coding problems and building projects because they help me learn something new every day. If I look back at the past year, I think my biggest improvement I've made is that I became much more disciplined, confident, and open to learning new projects. Earlier, I was mainly interested in frontend development. I loved designing and interfaces and building websites. But after some time, I realized that I wanted to understand how an entire application works, not just the not just what the users see. So I started learning backend development on my own. In the beginning, it really felt very difficult and challenging because there were so many things, so many concepts like APIs, databases, authentication, server-side development, and much more. But instead of getting discouraged, I kept building projects, reading documentation, and learning from my mistakes. Recently, I've also started exploring tools like Docker because I want to understand how applications are deployed in real-world environments. Along with improving technically, I also worked on myself as a person. I became more disciplined by following a daily routine and staying consistent with my learning. I also realized that communication is just as important as the technical skills are. Earlier, I was very underconfident while explaining my ideas, but then I started working on it. I started speaking more during presentations. I used to discuss with my friends, used to tell them how what what my projects are all about, their working, and yeah, I practiced whenever I got the chance. Over time, I became much more comfortable in expressing myself. So this whole journey taught me that growth doesn't happen overnight. It's the small, small things which you do every day which, you know, just make the biggest difference. I still have to learn a lot of things, but today, if I look back at my past year, yeah, so I'm much more confident, disciplined, and excited to keep improving myself. Thank you so much.
summary: Akshita Sood, a B.Tech Computer Science student at VIT Bhopal University, shared a reflection on her personal and technical growth over the past year. Initially focused on frontend development, she expanded her skill set into full-application and backend development, learning concepts such as APIs, databases, authentication, and Docker. Alongside technical learning, she improved her personal discipline by maintaining a daily routine. She also enhanced her confidence and communication skills through presentations and peer discussions.
keyPoints: Transitioned from frontend UI design to backend development to gain a complete understanding of application architecture.
Learned key backend concepts including APIs, databases, authentication, server-side development, and containerization using Docker.
Developed personal discipline and consistency through a daily routine dedicated to continuous learning.
Improved presentation and communication skills by actively presenting ideas and explaining project workflows to peers.
